Welcome to emoji party!

Let's teach you how to play!
Tap the letter to place it in the highlighted tile.
Tap the wrongly placed letter to return it.
Use hint to auto place the correct letter.
Use shuffle to rearrange the letters.
Use reveal to know the first emoji name.
Use reveal again to know the next emoji name.
Use trash to return the wrongly placed letters.
Fill the remaining letters to complete the level!
